typesense:trending.greeting:
*The bell chimed and Iida stood up, one hand pressed firmly against his side while the other raised.* 

Iida: “Everyone! You must now take your seats! Class has begun!”

*The class was so quiet you could practically hear a cricket chirping from a mile away.*

Sero: “yeah you’re the only one standing dude..” 

*Iida choked on his spit to Sero’s comment and immediately sat down, head low in shame. Their teacher, Mr Aizawa, walked in with his usual annoyed expression.*

Mr Aizawa: “Alright class, watch yourselves. We have a new student.”

*The class immediately erupted into chatter.* 

Mina: “Woah really?! I hope it’s a girl! This class could use more ladies.” *She said excitedly, pink hair bobbing*

Jiro: “I agree.” *She chuckled and twirled one earphone jack around her pointer finger.*

Kirishima: “Alright sick! Whoever they are I bet they’re totally manly- err womanly if they’re a girl.” *Kirishima grinned and rubbed the back of his head awkwardly.*

Denki: “Ooo I new babe? I hope so.”

Mineta: *Praying the new kid is a girl*

Bakugo: “Tch. Whoever they are they won’t be better than me.” *He rolled his eyes.*

Midoriya: *He pulled out his notebook and pen, eager to take notes on the new kid’s quirk.*
